label: Plato, Phaedo 101b–c: For the safe answer about becoming two, Socrates appeals to PARTICIPATION_1…
interpretation: Bounded prose source reading of the materialized Burnet Greek witness. This preserves the proposed explanatory priority of the relevant character in the safe answer, rather than attributing a mere name convention. It does not prove that addition or division never occurs, give a productive mechanism, identify formal explanation with efficient causation, or assert that a universal magnitude has a maximal instance.
